articles.title: Uncapped Notts spinner Patterson-White earns England Test call-up for South Africa
articles.summary: 28-year-old rewarded for county performances. Bashir to tour with Lions along with seamer Carse. The uncapped Nottinghamshire spinner Liam Patterson-White has been rewarded for his most productive County Championship season with a call-up up to England’s squad for their first red-ball assignment of…
body: The potential importance of spin bowling in South Africa was demonstrated in their recent home series against Australia, which the hosts won to propel themselves to No1 in the ICC rankings and in which their most successful bowler was Simon Harmer, who took 14 wickets at 29.35. England will face contrasting conditions, particularly in their first two Tests, and have selected further spin-bowling options in Dan Lawrence, Joe Root and Jacob Bethell, who returns after missing England’s most recent Test series, against Pakistan, through injury, But Shoaib Bashir, a fixture of the country’s Test squads since he made his debut in India in 2024, will travel only with the Lions.

“We’ve got two Tests in the Highveld, which is slightly different to what Australia had,” said Marcus North, England men’s national selector. “Highveld tends to not spin as much, so it tends to be more favourable for the pace bowlers. But we feel we’ve got that balance within our squad that if we didn’t pick a specialist spinner we have got plenty of options that could support four quicks.”

articles.title: Trump’s pathetic Dana White gambit could not mask his midterm humiliation | Howard Bryant
articles.summary: Trump has long relied on sports to project strength and fuel his culture wars. But after a crushing midterm defeat, even his UFC ally cannot distract from the political fallout.
body: I n the wake of being destroyed in the midterm elections, it was only a matter of time before Donald Trump did something outrageous in an attempt to misdirect public attention away from his catastrophic losses. Before the midterms, published reports suggested the possibility of apocalypse, global or domestic – a nuclear strike on Iran, martial law to suspend last week’s, the invalidation of individual races, such as in Alaska – but Trump opted for banality over Armageddon, offering his vacant press secretary opening to Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White.

articles.title: Burn replaces injured Guehi in England squad
articles.summary: Newcastle's Dan Burn is added to the England squad to play Croatia and Spain in the Nations League this week after Marc Guehi pulls out with a hip injury.
body: Newcastle's Dan Burn has been added to the England squad to play Croatia and Spain in the Nations League this week after Manchester City defender Marc Guehi pulled out with a hip injury.
Guehi was substituted at half-time of City's loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday and manager Enzo Maresca said afterwards the centre-back had requested to come off because of the injury.
BBC Sport revealed on Sunday that the 26-year-old was having a scan to determine the severity of the ongoing issue, and the defender has now been ruled out of this week's matches.
The former Crystal Palace captain has been a mainstay of Thomas Tuchel's team since his appointment as England head coach in January 2025.

articles.title: ‘100% accurate’: Warner backs Khawaja over explosive ball-tampering claims
articles.summary: Former vice-captain breaks his eight-year silence. Test captain Pat Cummins is expected to face questioning this week. David Warner has broken his eight-year silence and says it is “100% accurate” that every player knew of the sandpaper plot, giving “full support” to Usman Khawaja.
body: The former vice-captain of the Test team also claimed Cricket Australia’s investigation was “rushed and botched”, as he backed his former teammate’s account in a social media video shared on Monday evening.
Khawaja wrote in his autobiography Sabr, out on Tuesday, that his teammates should accept collective responsibility for the incident and that more details are still not public.

The claims have resuscitated calls for players – including Test captain Pat Cummins – to address if they had any knowledge about the use of sandpaper to help the ball swing on the 2018 tour of South Africa.

Cummins and the current ODI captain Mitchell Marsh were part of the Australian side in Cape Town when Cameron Bancroft was caught applying sandpaper to the ball, an act which resulted in him – as well as captain Steve Smith and Warner – being suspended.

articles.title: Ramla Ali wins first world titles at 36 with highly controversial split decision
articles.summary: British-Somali boxer claims first world titles in Texas. Kreps outlands Ali but loses disputed split decision. Baumgardner wins 135lb belt as Dubois feud heats up. Australia’s Nicolson retains junior featherweight title.
body: British-Somali boxer Ramla Ali became a world champion for the first time at the age of 36 on Sunday night after escaping with a highly contentious 10-round split decision over former sparring partner Mikiah Kreps to claim the vacant WBO and IBF women’s junior featherweight titles in Arlington, Texas.

Ali, who grew up in east London after fleeing Somalia’s civil war with her family and went on to become the first boxer to represent the African country at the Olympics, completed her remarkable journey to the top of the 122lb division at College Park Center on her second attempt at a world championship – but only after a controversial verdict rewarding her for a fight that appeared to be largely controlled by her opponent.

“I can’t put into words what this means to me and what this means to all of Somalia,” a visibly emotional Ali said in the immediate aftermath. “I’ve hopefully inspired so many young girls and boys out there to dream big and that’s all I’ve ever wanted to do.”
Ali (12-2, 3 KOs) took the upper hand early after scoring a knockdown in the third round when Kreps touched the canvas with her glove after taking a right hook flush to the chin.

body: All-rounder Patterson-White helped Nottinghamshire win the Championship title in 2025 by taking 26 wickets and scoring 540 runs in 11 appearances, and then claimed 42 wickets and scored 474 runs in 14 appearances last season.

Bethell did not feature in August and September's 3-0 sweep of Pakistan due to a knee problem that required surgery but he is back to add to England's batting options for a tour that is live in full on Sky Sports across December and January in what will be Stephen Fleming's first series as head coach.
Jordan Cox deputised for Bethell at No 3 versus Pakistan, scoring a half-century in each of the three Tests at Headingley, Lord's and Edgbaston.
The Essex player's displays have opened up a selection dilemma, with possibly only three spots available between Cox, Bethell, Emilio Gay and Dan Lawrence.

articles.title: Neville: Is Man City charges spotlight seeping into performances?
articles.summary: Gary Neville has questioned whether the recent attention over Manchester City being charged by the Premier League has begun to seep into the team's performances.
body: The club were found guilty of 114 serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules in September. Man City deny all the charges and have lodged an appeal against the verdict. No sanctions have yet been announced.
However, Enzo Maresca's side have now lost their last three matches in the Premier League, including a 3-1 defeat to Nottingham Forest at the weekend.
It has seen them slip into third place - six points behind leaders Arsenal - and Sky Sports pundit Neville says the external attention cannot be ruled out as a contributing factor to their form.
He told NBC Sports' Premier League Mornings: "Something's just not right at the moment and worrying. Things point towards the obvious cloud hanging over the club.

articles.summary: Sean Jansen is ruled out of the remainder of Ireland's Nations Championship campaign with a knee injury, further depleting head coach Andy Farrell's options at number eight.
body: With Caelan Doris and Jack Conan already injured, Jansen was forced off during Friday's 42-12 win over Argentina in Dublin and will return to Connacht to continue his rehabilitation.

Hooker Dan Sheehan will miss Saturday's home match with Fiji (20:10 GMT) after sustaining a concussion against the Pumas, but the coaching staff are "hopeful" wing Rob Baloucoune (cramp) and flanker Josh van der Flier (ankle) will be available.
Sheehan - squad captain in Doris' absence - is a doubt for the South Africa game on 21 November as he undergoes 12-day return-to-play protocols.
With mounting back-row injury issues, uncapped Ulster forward David McCann has been called up, while Gus McCarthy has joined the squad to boost Farrell's options at hooker.

articles.title: Old Firm the top two, but are Falkirk this season's surprise package?
articles.summary: It is as you were at the top of the Scottish Premiership heading into the second international break, but Falkirk's incredible rise has taken many by surprise.
body: John McGlynn's side are on a five-game winning run during which they have beaten champions Celtic and ended Hearts' incredible 19-month unbeaten run at Tynecastle Park.
The Bairns are now third in the Scottish Premiership - at the last international break, they were down in 11th after winning just one of their first six games of the season.
McGlynn guided Falkirk to a sixth-placed finish in their first season back in the top flight, but a summer overhaul had even the manager himself questioning what they could achieve this season.
Top-scorer Barney Stewart moved to West Brom for a club-record fee, Calvin Miller joined Hearts and Dylan Tait made the switch to Dundee United.

articles.title: Brown, 19, becomes youngest PGA winner in 95 years
articles.summary: Teenager Blades Brown beats Ben James at the World Wide Technology Championship in Mexico to become the youngest PGA Tour tournament winner since 1938.
body: Nineteen-year-old Blades Brown became the youngest winner on the PGA Tour in 95 years with a thrilling victory in the World Wide Technology Championship in Mexico.
Brown beat fellow American Ben James on the second play-off hole in Cabo San Lucas after shooting a nine-under-par 63, which included a birdie on the 18th, to come from seven shots behind.
At 19 years and 171 days, he is the youngest PGA winner since 18-year-old Charles Kocsis won the 1931 Michigan Open, which was considered a regional event in the early years of the tour.
Brown is the first teenage PGA winner since Jordan Spieth won the John Deere Classic in 2013 at 19 years and 352 days.

Ex-opener Warner also said Cricket Australia's investigation process following the incident was "rushed and botched".
Australia were found to have used sandpaper to alter the condition of the ball during the third Test against South Africa in Cape Town.
Warner and captain Steve Smith were banned for a year and fellow batter Cameron Bancroft for nine months.

body: Brighton head into the international break proudly sitting second in the Premier League after Sunday's 2-0 win against Brentford.
Fabian Hurzeler's side have moved above far wealthier clubs including Manchester City, Liverpool and Chelsea, with leaders Arsenal only five points ahead of the high-flying Seagulls.
Brighton's climb towards the top of the table could easily be written off as a brief blip before the league's traditional powers reassert their supremacy.

But that would be to ignore the rock-solid foundations laid by Hurzeler and Albion's astute owner Tony Bloom, a professional gambler who has transformed Brighton since taking a major gamble when he bought the club in 2009.

articles.title: Vikings vs. Bills prediction, odds, line: Josh Allen faces NFL's top defense on Monday night
articles.summary: Josh Allen and Buffalo's explosive offense face Brian Flores' dominant defense, while Carson Wentz replaces the injured Kyler Murray
body: In the Week 9 edition of "Monday Night Football," the Minnesota Vikings host the Buffalo Bills. Minnesota is coming off its first loss of the season after starting the year with six straight wins. The Vikings turn to Carson Wentz to start in place of Kyler Murray, who is dealing with a hamstring injury. Minnesota sports arguably the NFL's best defense, and it will be put to the test on Monday night against the Bills.

Buffalo has won three consecutive games to improve to 6-1, and last week beat up on the Baltimore Ravens following an injury to Lamar Jackson on the Ravens' first snap of the game. Buffalo is in first place in the AFC East behind its efficient and explosive offense, which has helped offset a defense that has been highly vulnerable this year.
Will the Vikings bounce back, or will the Bills continue to roll? We'll find out soon enough. Before we break down the matchup, here's a look at how you can watch the game.
